## Relationships

### [Maurice Lennox](../character/maurice-lennox.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/averil--maurice-lennox.md)

Averil is opposed to [Maurice Lennox](../character/maurice-lennox.md), who acts as an adversary toward her. Starting in Volume 3, Lennox persecutes Averil in the role of a story's villain.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Atonement” P32](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0032)_

- Enemy of — persecuted by him as the villain in a story  <sub>[v3 ch.Atonement” P32](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0032)</sub>

### [Perceval](../character/perceval.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/averil--perceval.md)

[Perceval](../character/perceval.md) is connected to Averil as a romantic figure within Anne's narrative. Beginning in Volume 3, he serves as her fictional lover and sweetheart in the story.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Down P22](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0022)_

- Romantically involved with — fictional lover/sweetheart in Anne's story  <sub>[v3 ch.Down P22](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0022)</sub>
